name: @pipeworx/mcp-ban-fr

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Forward-geocode a French address, street, locality or commune. Returns scored GeoJSON matches (score 0-1) with label, coordinates, postcode, citycode (INSEE) and context. France only.

q.description: Free-text query, e.g. "8 bd du port" or "rue de la paix paris".

citycode.description: Filter by INSEE commune code, e.g. "95127".

autocomplete.description: Treat q as a partial/autocomplete prefix (default false).

lat.description: Latitude to bias/prioritise results geographically (pair with lon).

lon.description: Longitude to bias/prioritise results geographically (pair with lat).

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Reverse-geocode a coordinate to the nearest French address/feature. Returns scored GeoJSON matches with label, postcode, citycode (INSEE), context and distance (metres). France only.

tools.name: search_municipality
tools.description: Look up a French commune (municipality) by name to resolve its INSEE citycode, postcode, population and centre coordinates. Shortcut for geocode with type=municipality.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ban-fr forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ban-fr pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
